doc: RetPushSubscription is the push subscription of the browser, which a [CallPushSubscribe] has created or a [CallPushUnsubscribe] has removed.

1.doc: Endpoint is the URL of the push service, which delivers a message to this browser.
1.name: Endpoint

2.doc: P256dh is the public key of the browser in base64url.
2.name: P256dh

3.doc: Auth is the authentication secret of the browser in base64url.
3.name: Auth

4.doc: Origin is the origin of the application, as the browser sees it, e.g. https://example.com.
4.name: Origin

5.doc: UserAgent is the user agent of the browser, which helps the user to tell the devices apart.
5.name: UserAgent
